interpretation: PTOAnalyzer findings are evidence and follow-up clues only. Profiles contain no correctness result or Clean Latency; none of the tool outputs establishes a performance bottleneck.

protected_archive_validation.method: SHA-256 compared each indexed archive file against both artifact index and PTOBench protection manifest; session, events, and artifact index also matched protected hashes.

sample_selection.selection_reason: Eight successful combined profiles cover one-, two-, and eight-device samples, CSA/MoE/CP shapes, multiple model families, and a simple control. The remaining 8 profiles were also replayed for format coverage.

representative_raw_fact_audit.method: Independently parsed raw SHA-256-verified archive bytes and compared tool values, units, source paths, and source hashes.
